headline: <cite index="1-1">Refex Life Sciences acquires 100% of Modepro India, transitioning from Kavalam family founding promoters to new corporate management</cite>
sum: Refex Life Sciences acquires 100% of Modepro India from the Kavalam family. Modepro is a pharmaceutical company specializing in the manufacture of advanced intermediates for active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and fine chemicals.
implication: Consolidation of advanced pharma intermediate supply within Refex Life Sciences-aligns Modepro with RLFC (APIs) and Extrovis (speciality CRDMO) to create vertically integrated pharma value chain; hiving-off of identified assets and MIDC approvals indicate asset segregation or facility carve-out issues likely tied to Maharashtra industrial park compliance.
detail: <cite index="1-1">Refex Life Sciences has acquired 100% of Modepro, transitioning the entity from founding promoters (Kavalam family) to new corporate management</cite>. <cite index="1-5">Rajani Associates' role included legal diligence, advising on hiving-off of identified target assets, MIDC Agreements approvals, and transaction documentation</cite>. <cite index="46-5">This acquisition strengthens Refex Life Sciences' pharmaceutical value chain, combining RLFC (APIs), Modepro (Advanced Intermediates), and Extrovis (Speciality Formulation CRDMO)</cite>. <cite index="11-3,11-6">Modepro's registered office is in Chembur, Mumbai; its manufacturing facility is strategically located at Kurkumbh MIDC, Pune</cite>.
